VALUATION_RELATIVE_V1.formula: arithmetic_mean(required valuation component scores); every declared mandatory component required
VALUATION_RELATIVE_V1.componentScoring: lower multiple / higher yield is better after explicit N/A treatment; peer and self-history percentiles use PEER_SELF_PERCENTILE_V1
VALUATION_RELATIVE_V1.negativeDenominatorBehavior: metric becomes explicit NOT_APPLICABLE only when methodology declares it; another required valuation component must remain available

RELATIVE_MOMENTUM_V1.formula: 0.50 * score(12M total return vs approved benchmark) + 0.30 * score(6M total return vs benchmark) + 0.20 * score(12M drawdown recovery)
